fallback.notes: A frozen encoder is a dependency of a bi-encoder scorer, never a selected model. Without it the scorer is unavailable and the deterministic baseline serves.

licence.redistribution_notes: Apache-2.0, declared by the model card metadata and the LICENSE file (11343 bytes) at the pinned commit. First-party weights, unmodified. AlixAI does not bundle weights: the operator fetches the pinned file. Final sign-off is the human licence review (D-H01, M5-H02).

name: Qwen3-8B frozen encoder (bf16 safetensors)
notes: Role: the frozen encoder under CLM-v0.1-8B (entry clm-v0.1-8b lists this entry as a frozen-encoder dependency). It is never the default for a role or profile (the schema and the loader refuse it) and it generates nothing in this use.

One entry stands for a directory of files. artifact.filename names shard 1 of 5 because the registry records one file; the other shards are pinned at the same revision in deploy/container/clm/config/pins.txt (D-06), which the sidecar entrypoint re-hashes at every start. Shard sha256 (hub LFS oid, fetched 2026-10-08 at the pinned commit): 2 = 5991236cea6fe21f3d43cab0f0e84448734fbbe0789816202989f2ddc9d18282 (3993160032 bytes), 3 = c5185c4794be2d8a9784d5753c9922db38df478ce11f9ed0b415b7304d896836 (3959604768), 4 = b5ee7de71fbf17db3d5704e0c8f2bc7d005ca9e1d7ca2aeb19827b0cfcaa917a (3187841392), 5 = 20c2d6366ab85c90786ccdd829cd2b9e7d30ef3b2ebbb998280e7e4014b542ff (1244659840). models.Verify checks shard 1 only; verifying the full set stays the entrypoint's job.

Size: the five shards total 16381516776 bytes (15622 MiB) and the hub reports 8190735360 BF16 parameters (https://huggingface.co/api/models/Qwen/Qwen3-8B, fetched 2026-10-08). Resident memory is unmeasured; the weights alone are about 15.6 GiB, so the encoder cannot sit inside the lite (5811 MiB) or balanced (12134 MiB) container budget unquantised (docs/operations/resource-budgets.md section 4.4). A quantised encoder is a different artefact and would need its own entry and CLM evidence.

Context: the card gives 32768 tokens natively and 131072 with YaRN (README at the pinned commit). context.budget_tokens 2048 is the CLM state limit (states over 2048 tokens are truncated, CLM repo README, reviewed 2026-10-02), not a measurement.
Languages: the card claims 100+ languages and dialects without a list; claimed_count stays null because "100+" is not a number. Unqualified by AlixAI.

Runtime: vLLM serves the encoder for the CLM service (CLM README, reviewed 2026-10-02). backend.allowed_runtime_versions is empty: no vLLM version was run here, so every runtime version is denied (fail closed).

The scorer is advisory: it only scores a bounded set of authorised candidates and every selected id is re-resolved by the deterministic adapter; it never authorises, validates, prepares, confirms or commits (master plan 3, 8.5).
